pages.text: Attributes:$(br2)$(li)Three Values (Satisfaction, Magic, Wonder): Increases as tourists interact with buildings. When all three are maxed out, town experience increases, and special tourists leave resumes.$(br2)$(li)Wallet: Affects purchase quantity in shops, directly impacting town revenue.$(br2)$(li)Lodging: Affects maximum days stayed.$(br2)$(li)Energy: Affects the number of buildings visited.$(br2)Behavior: Tourists interact at building interact spots. If a spot is in use, tourists queue up.$(br2)At night, tourists seek hotels. If no room is available, they leave town.$(br2)Right-click a tourist to view the above information.
